entry.title: Slow Ops Looper 1.1.0
entry.summary: Looper by Slow Ops is a three-bank stereo looper for Akai MPC standalone. It captures 1, 2, 4 or 8 bars from a track in time with the MPC. You can overdub, start and stop banks on the beat, and use the built-in metronome. ![The LOOPS page on an MPC XL with two banks playing](https://github.com/drj-io/SlowOps.MPC.Looper/releases/download/v1.1.0/looper-loops-page.png) ## Upgrading from 1.0: restart the MPC The plugin is now called **Looper**. In 1.0 the MPC cut its name down to "Slow .ooper". 1. D
